# WheelChaired

> > Comprehensive wheelchair accessibility resource featuring product reviews, Medicare guidance, and accessible living solutions for wheelchair users.

WheelChaired is a United Spinal Association member site providing expert reviews of mobility equipment from brands like Drive Medical and Forcemech, along with practical guides for wheelchair accessibility, DIY modifications, and adaptive living. Founded by Jeff Conner, the site serves as a trusted resource for the wheelchair user community.

## Key Topics

- Wheelchair accessibility
- Product reviews and equipment guides
- Medicare coverage and resources
- Drive Medical wheelchairs
- All-terrain wheelchairs
- Accessible home design
- Wheelchair ramps and modifications
- Mobility aids and adaptive equipment
- DIY wheelchair projects
- United Spinal Association
- Wheelchair batteries and maintenance
- Accessible trails and outdoor activities
- Universal design principles
- Disability resources and advocacy

## Getting Started

- [Wheelchaired - Your Guide to Wheelchair Accessibility](https://wheelchaired.com/): Homepage with wheelchair guides, product reviews, and Medicare resources
- [About Us - WheelChaired](https://wheelchaired.com/about/): About WheelChaired, United Spinal Association member and disability blog

## Product Reviews & Equipment Guides

- [Wheelchaired - Your Guide to Wheelchair Accessibility](https://wheelchaired.com/2): Product reviews featuring Drive Medical wheelchairs and mobility aids
- [Top 10 Best All-Terrain Wheelchairs In 2026](https://wheelchaired.com/best-all-terrain-wheelchairs/): Top 10 all-terrain wheelchair reviews including Forcemech Navigator XL

## Accessibility Guides & Resources

- [Wheelchaired - Your Guide to Wheelchair Accessibility](https://wheelchaired.com/3): US wheelchair accessibility guides covering ramps, batteries, and DIY tips
- [10 Wheelchair-Friendly House Plan & Accessible Home Ideas](https://wheelchaired.com/wheelchair-friendly-house-plan/): 10 wheelchair-accessible house plans and universal design ideas
